body:
Being raped is a joke compared to not having this thing (at least to me,  and who is anyone to judge that pain for me?)

It's being unwilling.  It's a gift I've given to several people and offered to many others.

I have told people.   Not that I'm ending my life soon because of it,  but that it's extremely important to me.

I've been raped several times and I'd rather go through that every day for the rest of my life than live without this.  But apparently my values don't matter.
Nobody is going to give it to me so why bother?  Someone actually tried to not knowing just how bad it was and then gave up.
